title: AWS managed policy update
description: Lambda updated the AWSLambdaManagedEC2ResourceOperator managed policy to add the ec2:DescribeVpcEncryptionControls permission. For details, see Lambda updates to AWS managed policies.

title: Amazon S3 Express One Zone adds new AWS managed policies
description: Amazon S3 Express One Zone added new AWS-managed policies called AmazonS3ExpressFullAccess and AmazonS3ExpressReadOnlyAccess. For more information, see AWS managed policies for Amazon S3 Express One Zone.

title: RDS Custom for Oracle
description: End of support notice: On March 31, 2027, AWS will end support for Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle. For more information, see RDS Custom for Oracle end of support.

title: AWS Lambda Provisioned Mode for Kafka event source mappings (ESMs) now available in AWS Asia Pacific (Taipei) and AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
description: AWS Lambda now supports Provisioned Mode for event source mappings (ESMs) that subscribe to Apache Kafka event sources in the Asia Pacific (Taipei), AWS GovCloud (US-East), and AWS GovCloud (US-West) Regions. Provisioned Mode allows you to optimize the throughput of your Kafka ESM by provisioning event polling resources that remain ready to handle sudden spikes in traffic, helping you build highly responsive and scalable event-driven Kafka applications with stringent performance requirements.

description:

description: AWS Lambda durable functions are now available in 16 additional AWS Regions. title: Amazon Athena Spark adds support for AWS PrivateLink
description:
Amazon Athena Spark now supports AWS PrivateLink so that you can access APIs and endpoints from your Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) without traversing the public internet. This feature can help you meet compliance requirements by allowing you to access and use Athena Spark APIs and endpoints entirely within the AWS network.

title: AWS Lambda functions can now mount Amazon S3 buckets as file systems with S3 Files
description: AWS Lambda now supports Amazon S3 Files, enabling your Lambda functions to mount Amazon S3 buckets as file systems and perform standard file operations without downloading data for processing. Built using Amazon EFS, S3 Files gives you the performance and simplicity of a file system with the scalability, durability, and cost-effectiveness of S3. description:

title: Amazon MSK Replicator now supports enhanced consumer offset synchronization for bidirectional replication
description:
Amazon MSK Replicator now provides enhanced consumer offset synchronization for bidirectional replication, enabling applications to resume processing from the correct position when moving across Kafka clusters. This capability enables you to move producer and consumer applications between clusters independently, in any order, without the risk of data loss.

title: AWS Transform automates landing zone creation in migration workflows
description: AWS Transform now supports landing zone creation directly within migration workflows, delivering a secure, multi-account AWS environment tailored to your migration needs. By consolidating orchestration into AWS Transform, it automates the setup that previously required configuration across AWS Control Tower, AWS Organizations and AWS Identity and Access Management, accelerating migration readiness with a ready-to-deploy target environment. description:
